annotation.title_clean: Using Virtual Reality for scenario-based Responsible Research and Innovation approach for Human Robot Co-production
annotation.title_en: Using Virtual Reality for scenario-based Responsible Research and Innovation approach for Human Robot Co-production
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Aschenbrenner, D.; Van Tol, D.; Rusak, Z.; Werker, C.
annotation.venue: 3rd IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Virtual Reality (AIVR 2020)
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper proposing Virtual Reality scenarios within a Responsible Research and Innovation approach to explore stakeholder and worker reactions to collaborative robots in Industry 4.0 workplaces, aiming to design human-robot co-production perceived as teamwork rather than a job threat.
key_provisions_or_claims: Use VR scenarios to elicit stakeholder reactions to close human-robot collaboration before deployment
Workers fear job redundancy from Industry 4.0 robotics
RRI requires careful investigation of stakeholders' thoughts and feelings
Well-designed human-robot interaction can raise productivity and well-being
